metadata.title: Bo cau hoi don gian ve bao hiem y te

articles.label: Cau hoi 1
articles.title: Bao hiem y te dung de lam gi?
paragraphs: BHYT la cong cu giup chia se chi phi kham chua benh giua nguoi tham gia va quy bao hiem, giam goi bo tro chi tra khi om dau.
qas: BHYT ho tro nguoi tham gia nhu the nao?
Vi sao nen co the BHYT?

articles.label: Cau hoi 2
articles.title: Ai can tham gia BHYT?
paragraphs: Moi cong dan deu duoc khuyen khich tham gia. Nhieu nhom duoc nha nuoc dong thay nhu tre duoi 6 tuoi, nguoi ngheo, dong bao dan toc thieu so.
qas: Tre duoi 6 tuoi co phai dong BHYT khong?
Co nhung nhom nao duoc nha nuoc dong thay BHYT?

articles.label: Cau hoi 3
articles.title: The BHYT co thoi han bao lau?
paragraphs: The BHYT thong thuong co gia tri su dung 12 thang tinh tu ngay co hieu luc in tren the.
qas: The BHYT dung duoc trong bao lau?
Sau khi het han the BHYT can lam gi?

articles.label: Cau hoi 4
articles.title: Lam sao dang ky noi kham chinh?
paragraphs: Nguoi mua the chon co so tuyen quan, huyen, hoac benh vien duoc ghi tren the. Neu muon doi co so can lam don tai co quan BHXH.
qas: Dang ky noi kham BHYT o dau?
Co doi duoc noi kham BHYT khong?

articles.label: Cau hoi 5
articles.title: Quen mang the thi duoc giai quyet sao?
paragraphs: Nguoi dien khong co the van duoc cap cuu. Sau do can bo sung the hoac giay hen thay the de duoc huong quyen loi.
Nhieu co so chap nhan trai giay hen cap lai the.
qas: Quen the BHYT co duoc huong quyen loi khong?
Mat the BHYT thi lam gi?

articles.label: Cau hoi 6
articles.title: BHYT gia dinh dong the nao?
paragraphs: Tam nhan nhan vien BHXH dia phuong thu theo ho gia dinh. Nguoi thu 2 tro di se duoc giam dan ti le, toi da 5 nguoi chung so ho khau.
qas: Dong BHYT ho gia dinh co giam gia khong?
Can bao nhieu nguoi trong ho cung tham gia BHYT ho gia dinh?

articles.label: Cau hoi 7
articles.title: Sinh vien dong BHYT ra sao?
paragraphs: Sinh vien thuoc nhom bat buoc, nha truong thu va nop cho co quan BHXH. Nhieu truong ho tro mot phan chi phi dong.
qas: Sinh vien co bat buoc dong BHYT khong?
Nha truong tham gia thu BHYT nhu the nao?

articles.label: Cau hoi 8
articles.title: Nguoi lao dong cong ty dong BHYT ra sao?
paragraphs: Doanh nghiep va nguoi lao dong cung dong theo ti le luat dinh. Cong ty tru phan cua nguoi lao dong vao tien luong hang thang.
qas: Cong ty dong bao nhieu phan tram BHYT?
Khoan BHYT cua nhan vien bi tru vao o dau?

articles.label: Cau hoi 9
articles.title: Cap cuu ngoai tuyen duoc thanh toan khong?
paragraphs: Cap cuu duoc huong nhu dung tuyen vi uu tien cuu nguoi. Sau khi on dinh benh vien lam thu tuc gui BHXH de thanh toan.
qas: Cap cuu o benh vien khong dang ky co duoc thanh toan khong?
Thu tuc thanh toan cap cuu BHYT la gi?

articles.label: Cau hoi 10
articles.title: BHYT thanh toan bao nhieu phan tram chi phi?
paragraphs: Nguoi dung tuyen thuong huong 80 phan tram. Nguoi huong chinh sach xa hoi, nguoi ngheo duoc 95 hoac 100 phan tram tuy nhom.
qas: BHYT chi tra bao nhieu phan tram?
Nhung ai duoc 100 phan tram BHYT?

articles.label: Cau hoi 11
articles.title: Thuoc ngoai danh muc co duoc chi tra?
paragraphs: Quy BHYT chi chi tra thuoc co trong danh muc. Thuoc ngoai danh muc nguoi benh tu chi tra hoac xin ho tro khac.
qas: BHYT co tra thuoc ngoai danh muc khong?
Lam sao biet thuoc do nam trong danh muc BHYT?

articles.label: Cau hoi 12
articles.title: Kham ngoai tuyen duoc bao nhieu?
paragraphs: Khi tu y di ngoai tuyen khong trong truong hop cap cuu, ty le huong giam con 40 den 60 phan tram tuy tuyen huyen, tinh, trung uong.
qas: Kham ngoai tuyen thi BHYT tra bao nhieu phan tram?
Cap cuu ngoai tuyen co bi giam ti le khong?

articles.label: Cau hoi 13
articles.title: Co the doi thong tin tren the khong?
paragraphs: Neu sai ho ten, nam sinh, dia chi can nop don doi the tai co quan BHXH hoac qua dich vu cong. The moi se cap trong vai ngay.
qas: Sai thong tin tren the BHYT thi lam gi?
Mat bao lau de nhan the BHYT moi?

articles.label: Cau hoi 14
articles.title: Co phai chon benh vien kham dinh ky khong?
paragraphs: Nguoi tham gia phai chon co so tuyen theo quy dinh. Chi khi chuyen tuyen hoặc cap cuu moi duoc kham noi khac va van duoc thanh toan.
qas: Co duoc tu y den benh vien tuyen trung uong kham khong?
Lam sao de chuyen tuyen duoc quyet toan BHYT?

articles.label: Cau hoi 15
articles.title: Tre duoi mot tuoi co phai dong BHYT?
paragraphs: Tre duoi 6 tuoi duoc cap the mien phi tu ngan sach, khong can dong tien. Cha me can nop giay khai sinh hoac giay chung sinh de cap the.
qas: Tre so sinh co phai dong BHYT khong?
Thu tuc cap the BHYT cho tre duoi 6 tuoi la gi?

articles.label: Cau hoi 16
articles.title: Nguoi huong tro cap xa hoi co gi dat biet?
paragraphs: Nguoi huong tro cap xa hoi hang thang duoc quyen 100 phan tram chi phi kham chua benh dung tuyen, mot so dich vu con duoc ho tro them.
qas: Nguoi huong tro cap xa hoi duoc huong ti le BHYT bao nhieu?
Co can dong them tien khi kham khong?

articles.label: Cau hoi 17
articles.title: Khi chuyen tuyen can giay to gi?
paragraphs: Benh vien tuyen truoc phai cap giay gioi thieu chuyen tuyen noi ro ly do. Nguoi benh mang giay nay va the BHYT den noi nhan.
qas: Muốn chuyen tuyen thi can xin giay gi?
Khong co giay chuyen tuyen co duoc thanh toan nhu dung tuyen khong?

articles.label: Cau hoi 18
articles.title: Di lam xa nha thi dang ky BHYT the nao?
paragraphs: Nguoi lao dong co the chon noi kham theo noi dang o neu co giay tam tru hoac hop dong lao dong tai dia phuong do.
qas: Di lam xa co doi noi kham BHYT duoc khong?
Can gi khi dang ky noi kham BHYT tai noi tam tru?

articles.label: Cau hoi 19
articles.title: Bao gio duoc dung the moi sau khi dong?
paragraphs: Nguoi mua BHYT ca nhan thuong duoc cong nhan tu ngay mot thang ke tiep sau khi nop tien du du lieu. The duoc giao truoc ngay co hieu luc.
qas: Dong BHYT xong bao lau thi duoc su dung?
The BHYT co hieu luc ngay khi dong khong?

articles.label: Cau hoi 20
articles.title: Kham dinh ky co duoc BHYT chi tra?
paragraphs: BHYT chi huong khi kham, tri benh theo chi dinh y te. Kham suc khoe dinh ky theo yeu cau doanh nghiep khong nam trong pham vi thanh toan.
qas: Di kham suc khoe tong quat co duoc BHYT chi tra khong?
BHYT chi tra cho truong hop nao?
